texts: On day 630 of Year 2, the keepers of the East Row together lit the lanterns of the East Row at sundown.
The lanterns showed mist-light at night.
A crowd of nightmoths gathered at the East Row.
Four sky-cats descended from the cliff-spires.
The four sky-cats hunted the nightmoth crowd at the East Row.
The nightmoth crowd at the East Row shrank.
The surviving nightmoths fled to the Hollows.
The surviving nightmoths reached the Hollows.
The four sky-cats molted during the hunt.
The nightmoths left silken threads on the lanterns of the East Row.

q1_issues.issue: "The four sky-cats hunted the nightmoth crowd" is a counted definite plural with a non-collective predicate, so the per-member distribution rule over (PartOf $x sk_skycats_1) is due alongside the group event, but only the group event is emitted.

"The nightmoths left silken threads on the lanterns" likewise gets a group event with no per-member distribution rule, although leaving threads is distributive and every other plural-subject predicate in the parse (burn, show, descend, survive, flee, reach, molt) does get one.
"the East Row" is treated as a multi-word name but the kind word inside the name yields no type atom — the Kestrel-River rule directs that (Member east_row row) be stated beside the Name atom.

q2_gaps: An in-world calendar date ("on day 630 of Year 2"): the structured Time terms (Day n)/(Year n) are specified for Gregorian dates, and a day-of-year number far above 31 plus a bare regnal year are not addressed.

An anaphoric definite mass NP whose antecedent was encoded as a bare kind filler ("the lanterns produced mist-light" ... "The mist-light attracted nightmoths"): the bare-class rule gives the non-specific object the constant mist_light while the later definite mints sk_mistlight_1, and no rule links the two, so the passage's causal chain is severed.

An agent-nominalization's of-phrase ("the keepers of the East Row"): the nominalization test ("the N of X" ~ "what Vs X" -> the surface-preposition oblique (Of ...)) and the true-relational-noun/role carve-out (-> Possession) both fit a -er noun with a live underlying verb, and nothing selects between them.
review.notes: The collective/distributive split is otherwise handled exactly as specified — bare "together" suppresses the rule for lit and produced, and gather and shrink stay group-only — which makes the two missing rules read as omissions rather than collective readings. "the Hollows" is correctly Name-only with no type atom and no GroupOf, and the During link on the molting and the LocatedIn on the nightmoth crowd both follow the instruction set.

issues.reason: Cardinality states it flatly — a plural with a distributive predicate keeps the group + count + group event and ADDS the per-member rule over (PartOf $x <group>) — and "hunted" is neither a reciprocal/aggregate predicate nor marked "together"/"jointly" (this passage marks "together" exactly where it means collective), so the rule is owed and is missing.

Same rule: "The nightmoths left silken threads" is a definite plural subject with a distributive predicate — the trigger is grammatical number, not whether the referent happens to be a group — so the per-member rule over (PartOf $x sk_crowd_1) is due beside the group event and is missing.

Names and casing directs that a multi-word name's kind be stated in one ordinary type atom whether the kind word sits inside the name or beside it ("the Kestrel River" -> (Member kestrel_river river)), and "Row" is the kind word inside this name, so (Member east_row row) is licensed and owed rather than optional.

gaps_confirmed: In-world calendar date "day 630 of Year 2": (Day n)/(Year n) presume Gregorian day-of-month and calendar year, so a day-of-year count and a bare regnal year have no specified term

An anaphoric definite whose antecedent was encoded as a bare kind filler ("produced mist-light" … "The mist-light attracted nightmoths"): coreference is specified for a re-mentioned witness, not for a definite pointing at a bare class constant, so the parse mints sk_mistlight_1 and the causal chain is severed

An agent-nominalization's of-phrase ("the keepers of the East Row"): the of-object rule covers act/result/quality nominalizations and the genitive carve-out covers relational nouns "where no underlying verb exists" — a role noun that does have a live verb (keeper/keep) falls between them and nothing selects
new_gaps: A bare indefinite plural understood as a subset of an already-introduced group ("Some nightmoths survived the hunt", after "a crowd of nightmoths") gets no SubsetOf/PartOf link: the partitive machinery keys on explicit "of the / of them" wording, so the survivors group floats free of the crowd it came from
adjudication.defect_summary: Statement 52 needs, beside the group hunt event, the per-member rule (: skycats_hunt_rule (Implication (PartOf $x sk_skycats_1) (And (Member (sk_hunt $x) hunt) (Agent (sk_hunt $x) $x) (Patient (sk_hunt $x) sk_crowd_1) (Past (sk_hunt $x)))) (STV 1.0 0.9)). Statement 85 needs the parallel rule over (PartOf $x sk_crowd_1) carrying the leave bundle's class, subject role, threads role, Location and Past into the consequent. Statement 0 needs (: er_type (Member east_row row) (STV 1.0 0.99)) emitted beside the Name atom.
adjudication.notes: Independently of the filed issues, (Patient sk_leave_1 sk_threads_1) looks like the same object-change misapplication — deposited threads are moved, not altered, so Theme — but it was not filed, so I leave it unadjudicated. The collective/distributive split is otherwise handled as specified ("together" suppresses the rule for lit and produced; gather and shrink stay group-only), which is what makes the two missing rules read as omissions.
